about_the_game:
The Path of the Ancient God

Is it easy to be a god? Dark prophet Azrael is a representative of the ancient race. It was you who created elves, orcs, humans and all living things in this galaxy. A gloomy careerist, hiding under a hood his contempt for both the ancients and mortals, skillfully pretends to be a loyal servant of the hierarchs. But behind the backs of enemies and rulers, he has been hatching his plans for centuries. Your actions shape Azrael's character. Helping friends, saving mortals, noble deeds will change the hero's phrases, open and close opportunities. As well as betrayal, indifference and pride.

Empire above all!

The First Hierarch Ozymandias has already prepared orders for you. You will have to:

  • Build planets to extract resources

  • Fight the enemies of the Empire

  • Trade with other ancients

  • Assemble a squad of great mortal heroes

  • Hold auctions and exorcise demons

Dark Secrets of the Ancient Gods

Behind the beautiful facade of the greatest empire in the galaxy lie the dark secrets of a bloody history. A history full of conquests, the destruction of entire civilizations, fear, anger and envy.

You will have to discover terrible secrets and tear off the veil of lies in order to make your ultimate choice: who will be the god of this world.

short_description: Uncover the story of the dark prophet Azrael. For mortals you are a god, for your brothers - an office clerk, obediently serving the hierarchs of the Magistrarium. But one day everything can change. Somewhere in the darkness, a new god of this world patiently awaits you.
